title: Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria Human Anti-Human Antibodies Study
brief_summary: How does long term treatment with Soliris affect HAHA in PNH patients?
study_population: Patients with PNH previously enrolled in study E05-001, who have a eculizumab naive serum sample available for comparison, and who are currently receiving treatment with commerical Soliris.
